deploybot: Starting canary deploy for service-runtime v2026.03.1-canary (commit: b4f7a2d). Environment: prod-usw2. Initial traffic: 2%. Change window: 23:00-04:00 UTC. Auto-promote policy: hold unless no errs in 15m. Artifacts: registry.redwood.dev/runtime:b4f7a2d

alice.dev: thanks — watching latency and mem. pinning the tag for this run.

carol-sre: set alerts: p95 latency > 350ms & error-rate > 0.5% for 5m. hooking into ops-dash.

ben-platform: canary-router has split rule ready. if we need to rollback, say `rollback` and deploybot will revert.

deploybot: Smoke checks: passed (startup, healthcheck, basic inference). Observability trace ok. Canary traffic at 2% now. Next auto-check in 15m.

dave-eng: quick note — loadtest harness ran against canary, tail latency stable at 220ms. no OOMs. :thumbsup:

(15m later) deploybot: Canary evaluation complete. No rule breaches. Metrics: error-rate 0.12%, p95 290ms. Promoting to 20% traffic.

alice.dev: promote looks safe. moving to 20% then will run the integration smoke set.

ben-platform: pinned runtime version to v2026.03.1-canary on infra. command used: `./infra pin --svc runtime --tag v2026.03.1-canary --reason "canary pass"`

(40m after start) deploybot: Integration smoke tests passed at 20%. Rolling forward to 60% over 10m. Will pause for manual check after 10m.

carol-sre: monitoring OK. sampling traces for user journeys now. no anomalies so far.

erin-release: added release notes draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-01-runtime-canary (please review)

(1h after start) deploybot: Final verification passed. Promoting to 100% traffic. Final image: registry.redwood.dev/runtime:b4f7a2d (tag v2026.03.1-canary -> rolling to stable).

alice.dev: ack. tagging as v2026.03.1 and creating release. :rocket:

ben-platform: pinned stable tag and created rollback marker (for 30m) in case of late regressions.

deploybot: Canary deploy complete. Deployed to prod-usw2, 100% traffic. Commit: b4f7a2d, tag: v2026.03.1. Deploy duration: 1h07m. Change window still active until 04:00 UTC.

carol-sre: leaving monitors on for 2h post-deploy. will escalate if thresholds breach.

dave-eng: leaving a quick note — if anyone sees a purple spike in p99 please ping me and @carol-sre.

erin-release: final release notes published and changelog updated. https://confluence.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-01-runtime-release-notes

alice.dev: thanks team. rolling retrospective scheduled in #eng-releases for tomorrow to capture learnings.

ben-platform: nice run. great observability handoff.
